aggregation: Two full 20-case runs per path, order Python/C++/C++/Python; per-case median of two run medians, then geometric mean of speedups. Both paths use the same installed wheel and cached artifacts. Cold_graph_seconds fields are cached graph capture/first-call times in these runs, not NVRTC compilation.

isolated.timing: median 12 batches of 1000 host calls; allocation included in allocating calls; completion excluded; rotated provider order; no Dynamo wrapper
